note: Wooded hills between Benton and Oran with small fishing ponds and hiking and biking trails. One primitive camping spot, beside the gravel lot and picnic area at the end of the Park Road spur in the north tract. --Claude

flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites; Individual Campsites'. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas on the area map and are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period'; 'No open fires except at campsite'. Map (11/21/2025) legend 'Camping site'; one symbol, just south of the Parking + Picnic Area at the west end of the Park Rd spur = GIS 42. Imagery: lot 2341 is a gravel lot ~30 x 25 m at the end of a gravel drive in the woods; a 23-ft rig fits. Designated point beside a lot, not a ramp lot (the area's boat ramp is at Pond 3, 1.1 km S): stays. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.
PIN: stored 37.07523,-89.60713 = GIS 42, under trees at the lot's south edge. Nudge onto lot 2341: 37.07543,-89.60708.
CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: one camping point; the other five lots carry no camping symbol.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): Pond 1 is ~250 m N across woods; no water at the camp.
